## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem it Solves

Describe the problem or use case this feature would address. Why is this feature needed?

## 💭 Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. What would the user experience look like?

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds? Please describe them.

## 📊 Use Cases

Provide specific examples of how this feature would be used:

1. Use case 1...
2. Use case 2...
3. Use case 3...

## 🎨 Mockups/Examples

If applicable, add mockups, diagrams, or examples to help illustrate your idea.

## 📋 Additional Context

Add any other context, links, or information about the feature request here.

## 🔗 Related Issues

Link any related issues or discussions here.

**Note**: We appreciate your feedback! All feature requests are reviewed by our team.
